from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,sys

root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/codex_supervisor"))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"control/jobs"))
import full_a2z_governed_v4 as a2z
import experiment_gate as gate
import model_quality_gate as q

review_task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"
next_task="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
src=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees/DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-RETRY-20261006-E106/knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
dst=root/"knowledge/evidence/qualification/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4-GOVERNED"
if not src.exists():
    raise SystemExit("SOURCE_BUNDLE_MISSING")
if dst.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(dst)
shutil.copytree(src,dst)

overlay=json.loads((dst/"overlay.json").read_text())
review=a2z.import_review(dst,overlay,"POSTBUILD",review_task)
if review.get("decision")!="REVISE":
    raise SystemExit("EXPECTED_REVISE_GOT_"+str(review.get("decision")))

proposal=gate.proposal(dst,overlay)
previous_build=gate.build(dst,overlay)
pre_ref=q.expected_review_ref(overlay,"PREBUILD")
paths=sorted(previous_build["files"].keys())

context={
    "candidate_id":overlay["candidate_id"],
    "proposal":proposal,
    "proposal_sha256":overlay["experiment_proposal"]["sha256"],
    "prebuild_review_ref":pre_ref,
    "astra_postbuild_review":{
        "decision":review["decision"],
        "finding":review["finding"],
        "next_action":review["next_action"],
        "binding_sha256":review["binding_sha256"],
        "source_task_id":review["source_task_id"],
    },
    "previous_build_files":previous_build["files"],
}
prompt=(
 "You are exactly GPT-5.6 Sol. Revise the existing built implementation in response to the exact independent GPT-6 Astra POSTBUILD feedback below. "
 "The PREBUILD-approved R3 proposal remains authoritative; do not redesign or broaden scope. "
 "Return ONLY one JSON object with candidate_id, proposal_sha256, prebuild_review_ref and files. "
 "files must be a map containing exactly these complete UTF-8 artifact paths: "+", ".join(paths)+". "
 "Produce complete replacement contents, not patches. Preserve frozen controls, observations, safety flags, zero-cost/no-network constraints, and NO_PROVEN_EDGE semantics. "
 "Address every blocking issue in Astra finding/next_action. Do not execute code, tests, imports, measurements, tools, network calls, trades, paid actions or wallet actions. "
 "This is build revision only; the resulting files must return to GPT-6 Astra POSTBUILD review before any substantive test or measurement. "
 "Avoid markdown/code fences. CONTEXT_JSON:\n"+json.dumps(context,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)
)
if len(prompt)>100000:
    raise SystemExit("SOL_REBUILD_PROMPT_TOO_LARGE:"+str(len(prompt)))
a2z.request(dst,overlay,"SOL_BUILD",next_task,prompt)
print(json.dumps({"request_task_id":next_task,"phase":"SOL_BUILD","prompt_chars":len(prompt),"review_decision":review["decision"],"artifact_paths":paths},sort_keys=True))
